subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Estabelecer relações de interdiscursividade e intertextualidade para explicitar, sustentar e conferir consistência a posicionamentos e para construir e corroborar explicações e relatos, fazendo uso de citações e paráfrases devidamente marcadas.

components.description_pt: Identificar relações intertextuais e interdiscursivas que sustentam uma posição ou argumento em um texto
components.description_en: Identify intertextual and interdiscursive relationships that support a position or argument in a text
components.cc_component_description: Identify the central argument and specific claims made in a text

components.description_pt: Integrar citações de fontes confiáveis para fundamentar afirmações sobre um tópico
components.description_en: Integrate quotations from credible sources to substantiate claims about a topic
components.cc_component_description: Integrate quotations from credible sources to substantiate claims about a topic

components.description_pt: Citar ou parafrasear material de fonte com precisão evitando plágio
components.description_en: Quote or paraphrase source material accurately while avoiding plagiarism
components.cc_component_description: Quote or paraphrase source material accurately while avoiding plagiarism

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre paráfrase e citação direta ao reafirmar informações de formatos diversos
components.description_en: Distinguish between paraphrasing and direct quotation when restating information from diverse formats
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between paraphrasing and direct quotation when restating information from diverse formats

components.description_pt: Avaliar a consistência e coerência de posições apoiadas por referências intertextuais e interdiscursivas
components.description_en: Evaluate the consistency and coherence of positions supported by intertextual and interdiscursive references
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the soundness of a speaker's reasoning for logical consistency

cc_matches.description: Develop the topic with relevant, well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples.

Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources; assess the credibility of each source; and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and providing basic bibliographic information for sources.
Paraphrase portions of a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.
Delineate and evaluate the argument and specific claims in a text, including the validity of the reasoning as well as the relevance and sufficiency of the evidence.
Delineate a speaker's argument and specific claims, evaluating the soundness of the reasoning and the relevance and sufficiency of the evidence.
